record_title: Exact missing-mass covariance identity and sign reversal for successive species discoveries
provenance: An exact finite-sample covariance decomposition for consecutive species-discovery indicators, with finite iid constructions realizing both signs and a sharp analysis of a one-atom diffuse-tail limiting family.
limitations: Adjacent discoveries only; no global covariance extremum is claimed; the diffuse-tail optimum is family-specific; older occupancy and species-sampling literature remains a residual terminology-equivalence risk.
